desc: Ideation: confirm O(N^(1/3)) brute-force y-iteration is sufficient.
Implement `integer_cube_root(val)` robustly (binary search to avoid floating-point errors).
Iterate y from 1 to int(N**(1/3)) + a small constant, compute t = y**3 + N, x = integer_cube_root(t); verify x**3 - y**3 == N and x > y.
If a valid (x,y) is found, print `x y` and return.
If the loop finishes without success, print `-1`.
